findings.issue: Clarify that “largest barrier” means the largest activation-energy rise from a step’s starting energy level to its transition state, not necessarily the highest peak on the entire profile.
findings.evidence: This link adds standard AP-level chemistry rather than a claim explicitly stated in the supplied 5.10 excerpt. It is acceptable in the intended rate-limiting-step model; specifying how the barrier is measured would prevent a common misreading.
